title: Space bounded by the configuration count
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $x,w$ be Boolean words, and let $t,s$ be natural numbers. If $M$ computes $w$ from $x$ within $t$ steps and uses at most $s$ work-tape cells during those $t$ steps, then it computes $w$ from $x$ within $(|Q|+1)(|x|+2)3^{k(2s+1)}(2s+1)^k$ steps, where $Q$ is the state set of $M$ and $k$ is its number of work tapes.
hypotheses_covered: finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, with state set $Q$ and $k$ work tapes
space used by the computation through step $t$ is at most $s$
